import bpy
print([(o.name,len(o.data.polygons)) for o in bpy.context.scene.objects if o.type=='MESH'])

import numpy as np, itertools
mesh_triangles={}
depsgraph=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
for obj in bpy.context.scene.objects:
    if obj.type!='MESH': continue
    evaluated=obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
    mesh=evaluated.to_mesh()
    mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
    vertices=np.array([tuple(evaluated.matrix_world @ vertex.co) for vertex in mesh.vertices])
    mesh_triangles[obj.name]=vertices[np.array([tuple(triangle.vertices) for triangle in mesh.loop_triangles])]
    evaluated.to_mesh_clear()
def point_triangle_dist(points, triangles):
    edge1=triangles[...,1,:]-triangles[...,0,:]; edge2=triangles[...,2,:]-triangles[...,0,:]
    offset=points-triangles[...,0,:]
    normal=np.cross(edge1,edge2); norm2=np.sum(normal*normal,axis=-1)
    signed=np.sum(offset*normal,axis=-1)
    projected=offset-normal*(signed/np.maximum(norm2,1e-300))[...,None]
    dot11=np.sum(edge1*edge1,axis=-1); dot12=np.sum(edge1*edge2,axis=-1); dot22=np.sum(edge2*edge2,axis=-1)
    dotp1=np.sum(projected*edge1,axis=-1); dotp2=np.sum(projected*edge2,axis=-1)
    denominator=dot11*dot22-dot12*dot12
    coord1=(dot22*dotp1-dot12*dotp2)/np.maximum(denominator,1e-300)
    coord2=(dot11*dotp2-dot12*dotp1)/np.maximum(denominator,1e-300)
    inside=(coord1>=0)&(coord2>=0)&(coord1+coord2<=1)&(norm2>0)
    result=np.where(inside,signed*signed/np.maximum(norm2,1e-300),np.inf)
    for index in range(3):
        start=triangles[...,index,:]; direction=triangles[...,(index+1)%3,:]-start
        parameter=np.clip(np.sum((points-start)*direction,axis=-1)/np.maximum(np.sum(direction*direction,axis=-1),1e-300),0,1)
        delta=points-start-parameter[...,None]*direction
        result=np.minimum(result,np.sum(delta*delta,axis=-1))
    return result
def surface_distance(first,second):
    first=first[:,None,:,:]; second=second[None,:,:,:]
    best=np.inf
    for index in range(3):
        best=min(best,float(np.min(point_triangle_dist(first[...,index,:],second))),float(np.min(point_triangle_dist(second[...,index,:],first))))
    for index in range(3):
        start=first[...,index,:]; direction=first[...,(index+1)%3,:]-start
        edge1=second[...,1,:]-second[...,0,:]; edge2=second[...,2,:]-second[...,0,:]
        cross=np.cross(direction,edge2); determinant=np.sum(edge1*cross,axis=-1)
        inverse=np.divide(1.,determinant,out=np.zeros_like(determinant),where=abs(determinant)>1e-25)
        offset=start-second[...,0,:]; coord1=np.sum(offset*cross,axis=-1)*inverse
        cross2=np.cross(offset,edge1); coord2=np.sum(direction*cross2,axis=-1)*inverse
        parameter=np.sum(edge2*cross2,axis=-1)*inverse
        if np.any((abs(determinant)>1e-25)&(coord1>=0)&(coord2>=0)&(coord1+coord2<=1)&(parameter>=0)&(parameter<=1)): return 0.
        for other in range(3):
            other_start=second[...,other,:]; other_direction=second[...,(other+1)%3,:]-other_start
            offset=start-other_start
            dot11=np.sum(direction*direction,axis=-1); dot12=np.sum(direction*other_direction,axis=-1); dot22=np.sum(other_direction*other_direction,axis=-1)
            dot1=np.sum(direction*offset,axis=-1); dot2=np.sum(other_direction*offset,axis=-1)
            denominator=dot11*dot22-dot12*dot12
            param1=np.divide(dot12*dot2-dot22*dot1,denominator,out=np.zeros_like(denominator),where=abs(denominator)>1e-30)
            param2=(dot12*param1+dot2)/np.maximum(dot22,1e-300)
            valid=(param1>=0)&(param1<=1)&(param2>=0)&(param2<=1)&(abs(denominator)>1e-30)
            delta=offset+param1[...,None]*direction-param2[...,None]*other_direction
            best=min(best,float(np.min(np.where(valid,np.sum(delta*delta,axis=-1),np.inf))))
    return float(np.sqrt(best))
compact_matches=[]
for first_name,second_name in itertools.combinations(sorted(mesh_triangles),2):
    first=mesh_triangles[first_name]; second=mesh_triangles[second_name]
    gap=np.maximum(0,np.maximum(first.min(axis=(0,1))-second.max(axis=(0,1)),second.min(axis=(0,1))-first.max(axis=(0,1))))
    if np.linalg.norm(gap)>0.002: continue
    distance=surface_distance(first,second)
    if distance<=0.002: compact_matches.append((first_name,second_name,distance*1000))
print('count',len(compact_matches))
for first_name,second_name,distance in compact_matches: print(first_name,second_name,format(distance,'.9f'))

def reverse_intersects(first,second):
    first=first[:,None,:,:]; second=second[None,:,:,:]
    for index in range(3):
        start=first[...,index,:]; direction=first[...,(index+1)%3,:]-start
        edge1=second[...,1,:]-second[...,0,:]; edge2=second[...,2,:]-second[...,0,:]
        cross=np.cross(direction,edge2); determinant=np.sum(edge1*cross,axis=-1)
        inverse=np.divide(1.,determinant,out=np.zeros_like(determinant),where=abs(determinant)>1e-25)
        offset=start-second[...,0,:]; coord1=np.sum(offset*cross,axis=-1)*inverse
        cross2=np.cross(offset,edge1); coord2=np.sum(direction*cross2,axis=-1)*inverse
        parameter=np.sum(edge2*cross2,axis=-1)*inverse
        if np.any((abs(determinant)>1e-25)&(coord1>=0)&(coord2>=0)&(coord1+coord2<=1)&(parameter>=0)&(parameter<=1)): return True
    return False
compact_matches=[]
for first_name,second_name in itertools.combinations(sorted(mesh_triangles),2):
    first=mesh_triangles[first_name]; second=mesh_triangles[second_name]
    gap=np.maximum(0,np.maximum(first.min(axis=(0,1))-second.max(axis=(0,1)),second.min(axis=(0,1))-first.max(axis=(0,1))))
    if np.linalg.norm(gap)>0.002: continue
    distance=0. if reverse_intersects(second,first) else surface_distance(first,second)
    if distance<=0.002: compact_matches.append((first_name,second_name,distance*1000))
print('count',len(compact_matches))
for first_name,second_name,distance in compact_matches: print(first_name,second_name,format(distance,'.9f'))

limit=2.0/mm_per_unit

 for second in range(first+1,len(scan_meshes)):

  gap=np.maximum(0,np.maximum(one['lo']-two['hi'],two['lo']-one['hi']))
  lower=float(np.linalg.norm(gap))

def point_segment_sq(point,start,end):

 return dot_rows(delta,delta)

 normal=np.cross(edge_one,edge_two); norm_sq=dot_rows(normal,normal)
 offset=point-start
 height=dot_rows(offset,normal)/norm_sq
 projected=offset-height[...,None]*normal
 aa=dot_rows(edge_one,edge_one); ab=dot_rows(edge_one,edge_two); bb=dot_rows(edge_two,edge_two)
 pa=dot_rows(projected,edge_one); pb=dot_rows(projected,edge_two)

 bary_one=(pa*bb-pb*ab)/denom; bary_two=(pb*aa-pa*ab)/denom
 inside=(bary_one>=0)&(bary_two>=0)&(bary_one+bary_two<=1)
 best=np.minimum.reduce([point_segment_sq(point,tri[...,idx,:],tri[...,(idx+1)%3,:]) for idx in range(3)])
 return np.where(inside,np.minimum(best,height*height*norm_sq),best)
def segment_segment_sq(start_one,end_one,start_two,end_two):

 aa=dot_rows(edge_one,edge_one); ab=dot_rows(edge_one,edge_two); bb=dot_rows(edge_two,edge_two)

 denom=aa*bb-ab*ab

 interior=valid&(param_one>=0)&(param_one<=1)&(param_two>=0)&(param_two<=1)
 delta=offset+param_one[...,None]*edge_one-param_two[...,None]*edge_two
 best=np.minimum.reduce([point_segment_sq(start_one,start_two,end_two),point_segment_sq(end_one,start_two,end_two),point_segment_sq(start_two,start_one,end_one),point_segment_sq(end_two,start_one,end_one)])
 return np.where(interior,np.minimum(best,dot_rows(delta,delta)),best)
def segment_hits_triangle(start,end,tri):

import bpy

import numpy as np, itertools
from mathutils import Vector
mesh_triangles={}
depsgraph=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
for obj in bpy.context.scene.objects:
    if obj.type!='MESH': continue
    evaluated=obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
    mesh=evaluated.data
    coords=np.array([tuple(evaluated.matrix_world @ vertex.co) for vertex in mesh.vertices],dtype=float)
    triangles=[]
    for polygon in mesh.polygons:
        vertices=list(polygon.vertices)
        for index in range(1,len(vertices)-1): triangles.append(coords[[vertices[0],vertices[index],vertices[index+1]]])
    mesh_triangles[obj.name]=np.array(triangles)
def point_face_dist(points,triangles):
    origin=triangles[:,0]; edge_u=triangles[:,1]-origin; edge_v=triangles[:,2]-origin
    normal=np.cross(edge_u,edge_v); norm2=np.sum(normal*normal,axis=-1)
    offset=points[:,None,:]-origin[None,:,:]
    signed=np.sum(offset*normal[None,:,:],axis=-1)
    projection=offset-signed[:,:,None]*normal[None,:,:]/norm2[None,:,None]
    uu=np.sum(edge_u*edge_u,axis=-1); uv=np.sum(edge_u*edge_v,axis=-1); vv=np.sum(edge_v*edge_v,axis=-1)
    pu=np.sum(projection*edge_u[None,:,:],axis=-1); pv=np.sum(projection*edge_v[None,:,:],axis=-1)
    denominator=uu*vv-uv*uv
    bary_u=(pu*vv-pv*uv)/denominator; bary_v=(pv*uu-pu*uv)/denominator
    inside=(bary_u>=0)&(bary_v>=0)&(bary_u+bary_v<=1)
    return np.min(np.where(inside,signed*signed/norm2[None,:],np.inf))
def edges_of(triangles):
    return triangles.reshape(-1,3),triangles[:,[1,2,0],:].reshape(-1,3)
def segment_face_hit(starts,ends,triangles):
    direction=ends-starts; edge_u=triangles[:,1]-triangles[:,0]; edge_v=triangles[:,2]-triangles[:,0]
    cross=np.cross(direction[:,None,:],edge_v[None,:,:]); determinant=np.sum(edge_u[None,:,:]*cross,axis=-1)
    valid=np.abs(determinant)>1e-25
    inverse=np.divide(1.0,determinant,out=np.zeros_like(determinant),where=valid)
    offset=starts[:,None,:]-triangles[None,:,0,:]
    bary_u=np.sum(offset*cross,axis=-1)*inverse
    cross2=np.cross(offset,edge_u[None,:,:])
    bary_v=np.sum(direction[:,None,:]*cross2,axis=-1)*inverse
    parameter=np.sum(edge_v[None,:,:]*cross2,axis=-1)*inverse
    return np.any(valid&(bary_u>=0)&(bary_v>=0)&(bary_u+bary_v<=1)&(parameter>=0)&(parameter<=1))
def endpoint_edge_distance(points,starts,ends):
    direction=ends-starts
    offset=points[:,None,:]-starts[None,:,:]
    parameter=np.clip(np.sum(offset*direction[None,:,:],axis=-1)/np.sum(direction*direction,axis=-1)[None,:],0,1)
    delta=offset-parameter[:,:,None]*direction[None,:,:]
    return np.min(np.sum(delta*delta,axis=-1))
def mesh_distance(first,second):
    starts_a,ends_a=edges_of(first); starts_b,ends_b=edges_of(second)
    if segment_face_hit(starts_a,ends_a,second) or segment_face_hit(starts_b,ends_b,first): return 0.0
    minimum=min(point_face_dist(starts_a,second),point_face_dist(starts_b,first),endpoint_edge_distance(starts_a,starts_b,ends_b),endpoint_edge_distance(starts_b,starts_a,ends_a))
    direction_a=(ends_a-starts_a)[:,None,:]; direction_b=(ends_b-starts_b)[None,:,:]; offset=starts_a[:,None,:]-starts_b[None,:,:]
    aa=np.sum(direction_a*direction_a,axis=-1); ab=np.sum(direction_a*direction_b,axis=-1); bb=np.sum(direction_b*direction_b,axis=-1)
    ad=np.sum(direction_a*offset,axis=-1); bd=np.sum(direction_b*offset,axis=-1); denominator=aa*bb-ab*ab
    valid=denominator>1e-30
    parameter_a=np.divide(ab*bd-bb*ad,denominator,out=np.zeros_like(denominator),where=valid)
    parameter_b=np.divide(aa*bd-ab*ad,denominator,out=np.zeros_like(denominator),where=valid)
    valid &= (parameter_a>=0)&(parameter_a<=1)&(parameter_b>=0)&(parameter_b<=1)
    delta=offset+parameter_a[:,:,None]*direction_a-parameter_b[:,:,None]*direction_b
    minimum=min(minimum,np.min(np.where(valid,np.sum(delta*delta,axis=-1),np.inf)))
    return float(np.sqrt(minimum))
compact_matches=[]
for name_a,name_b in itertools.combinations(sorted(mesh_triangles),2):
    first=mesh_triangles[name_a]; second=mesh_triangles[name_b]
    gap=np.maximum(np.maximum(first.min(axis=(0,1))-second.max(axis=(0,1)),second.min(axis=(0,1))-first.max(axis=(0,1))),0)
    if np.linalg.norm(gap)>0.002: continue
    distance=mesh_distance(first,second)
    if distance<=0.002: compact_matches.append((name_a,name_b,distance*1000))
print('MATCHES',len(compact_matches))
for name_a,name_b,distance in compact_matches: print(name_a,name_b,format(distance,'.9f'))

import bpy
print([(obj.name, len(obj.data.polygons)) for obj in bpy.context.scene.objects if obj.type == 'MESH'])

import numpy as np
import itertools
mesh_triangles = {}
depsgraph = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
for obj in bpy.context.scene.objects:
    if obj.type != 'MESH':
        continue
    evaluated = obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
    mesh = evaluated.to_mesh()
    mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
    coordinates = np.array([tuple(evaluated.matrix_world @ vertex.co) for vertex in mesh.vertices])
    mesh_triangles[obj.name] = coordinates[np.array([tuple(triangle.vertices) for triangle in mesh.loop_triangles])]
    evaluated.to_mesh_clear()
def dot_vectors(first, second):
    return np.sum(first * second, axis=-1)
def point_triangle_sq(points, triangles):
    origin = triangles[...,0,:]
    edge_first = triangles[...,1,:]-origin
    edge_second = triangles[...,2,:]-origin
    normal = np.cross(edge_first, edge_second)
    normal_sq = dot_vectors(normal,normal)
    signed = dot_vectors(points-origin, normal)
    projected = points - (signed/np.maximum(normal_sq,1e-300))[...,None]*normal
    relative = projected-origin

            edge_second = second[...,(other_index+1)%3,:]-start_second

print('mesh_count',len(objs))
scan=[]
for obj in objs:
    evaluated=obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
    mesh=evaluated.to_mesh()
    mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
    vertices=np.array([tuple(evaluated.matrix_world @ vertex.co) for vertex in mesh.vertices],dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1,3)
    indices=np.array([tuple(triangle.vertices) for triangle in mesh.loop_triangles],dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1,3)
    triangles=vertices[indices]
    scan.append({'name':obj.name,'vertices':vertices,'indices':indices,'triangles':triangles})
    print(obj.name, 'verts',len(vertices),'tris',len(triangles),'bounds', (vertices.min(axis=0).tolist(),vertices.max(axis=0).tolist()) if len(vertices) else None)
    evaluated.to_mesh_clear()

def dot_array(first,second):
    return np.sum(first*second,axis=-1)

def point_segment_sq(points,start,end):
    direction=end-start
    denom=dot_array(direction,direction)
    fraction=np.divide(dot_array(points-start,direction),denom,out=np.zeros(np.broadcast_shapes(points.shape[:-1],denom.shape)),where=denom>0)
    fraction=np.clip(fraction,0,1)
    return dot_array(points-start-fraction[...,None]*direction,points-start-fraction[...,None]*direction)

def projected_face_sq(points,triangle):
    origin=triangle[...,0,:]
    side_first=triangle[...,1,:]-origin
    side_second=triangle[...,2,:]-origin
    normal=np.cross(side_first,side_second)
    normal_sq=dot_array(normal,normal)
    delta=points-origin
    signed=dot_array(delta,normal)
    height=np.divide(signed,normal_sq,out=np.zeros_like(signed),where=normal_sq>0)
    projection=delta-height[...,None]*normal
    denom=dot_array(side_first,side_first)*dot_array(side_second,side_second)-dot_array(side_first,side_second)**2
    coord_first=np.divide(dot_array(side_second,side_second)*dot_array(projection,side_first)-dot_array(side_first,side_second)*dot_array(projection,side_second),denom,out=np.zeros_like(signed),where=denom>0)
    coord_second=np.divide(dot_array(side_first,side_first)*dot_array(projection,side_second)-dot_array(side_first,side_second)*dot_array(projection,side_first),denom,out=np.zeros_like(signed),where=denom>0)
    inside=(denom>0)&(coord_first>=0)&(coord_second>=0)&(coord_first+coord_second<=1)
    return np.where(inside,signed*height,np.inf)

def segment_face_hit(start,end,triangle):
    origin=triangle[...,0,:]
    side_first=triangle[...,1,:]-origin
    side_second=triangle[...,2,:]-origin
    direction=end-start
    cross_first=np.cross(direction,side_second)
    determinant=dot_array(side_first,cross_first)
    valid=determinant!=0
    inverse=np.divide(1.0,determinant,out=np.zeros_like(determinant),where=valid)
    delta=start-origin
    coord_first=dot_array(delta,cross_first)*inverse
    cross_second=np.cross(delta,side_first)
    coord_second=dot_array(direction,cross_second)*inverse
    along=dot_array(side_second,cross_second)*inverse
    return valid&(coord_first>=0)&(coord_second>=0)&(coord_first+coord_second<=1)&(along>=0)&(along<=1)

def triangle_pair_min(first,second):
    first=first[:,None,:,:]
    second=second[None,:,:,:]
    best=np.full((first.shape[0],second.shape[1]),np.inf)
    for vertex_index in range(3):
        best=np.minimum(best,projected_face_sq(first[...,vertex_index,:],second))
        best=np.minimum(best,projected_face_sq(second[...,vertex_index,:],first))
    for first_index in range(3):
        start_first=first[...,first_index,:]; end_first=first[...,(first_index+1)%3,:]
        best=np.where(segment_face_hit(start_first,end_first,second),0,best)
        start_second=second[...,first_index,:]; end_second=second[...,(first_index+1)%3,:]
        best=np.where(segment_face_hit(start_second,end_second,first),0,best)
        for second_index in range(3):
            start_second=second[...,second_index,:]; end_second=second[...,(second_index+1)%3,:]
            for points,start,end in [(start_first,start_second,end_second),(end_first,start_second,end_second),(start_second,start_first,end_first),(end_second,start_first,end_first)]:
                best=np.minimum(best,point_segment_sq(points,start,end))
            direction_first=end_first-start_first; direction_second=end_second-start_second; delta=start_first-start_second
            aa=dot_array(direction_first,direction_first); bb=dot_array(direction_first,direction_second); cc=dot_array(direction_second,direction_second)
            dd=dot_array(direction_first,delta); ee=dot_array(direction_second,delta)
            denominator=aa*cc-bb*bb
            along_first=np.divide(bb*ee-cc*dd,denominator,out=np.zeros_like(denominator),where=denominator>0)
            along_second=np.divide(aa*ee-bb*dd,denominator,out=np.zeros_like(denominator),where=denominator>0)
            valid=(denominator>0)&(along_first>=0)&(along_first<=1)&(along_second>=0)&(along_second<=1)
            residual=delta+along_first[...,None]*direction_first-along_second[...,None]*direction_second
            best=np.minimum(best,np.where(valid,dot_array(residual,residual),np.inf))
    return math.sqrt(max(0,float(best.min())))

started=time.time()
results=[]

threshold=0.002/scene.unit_settings.scale_length
